topic: Discussing daily routines, shopping habits, and household management.
grammar: Missing Auxiliary Verbs / Incorrect Verb Forms

pairs.said: This day, I have something to do at night, so I slept at a really late time, so I'm really tired, but it's okay.
pairs.natural: I had something to do last night, so I went to bed really late, and I'm quite tired today, but it's okay.

pairs.said: the more it's a normal day, every person is a little busy, so they don't have time to go shopping.
pairs.natural: On weekdays, most people are quite busy, so they don't have time to go grocery shopping.

pairs.said: I think that is the etiquette, do not do laundry on the weekend night.
pairs.natural: I think it's proper etiquette not to do laundry on weekend nights.

vocab.meaning: 약속, 전념, 헌신 (특히 해야 할 일)
